issuing_service.description: Issuing service in the heading, e.g. 'American Consular Service'

visa_type.description: Kind of visa in the heading, e.g. 'Quota Immigration Visa'

file_number.description: File number handwritten at the top right of the page

quota.description: The quota the immigrant is charged to, from the (Quota.) blank

issue_date.description: Date the visa was issued, as YYYY-MM-DD

expiry_date.description: Date the visa's validity expires, as YYYY-MM-DD

alternate_name.description: Any other name typed in parentheses under the bearer's name

nationality.description: Nationality, from the (Citizen or subject.) blank

issued_by.description: Authority and place that issued the passport

issue_date.description: Date the passport was issued, as YYYY-MM-DD

valid_until.description: Date the passport is valid until, as YYYY-MM-DD

governing_law.description: The act under which the visa is granted, e.g. 'Immigration Act of 1924'

consular_officer_title.description: Title printed under the signing officer's signature, e.g. 'Vice Consul'
